title: IQM and AMD Demonstrate Reproducible Hybrid QPU-GPU Chemistry Workflow Using ROCm - Quantum Computing Report
gist: IQM and AMD ran an end-to-end hybrid QPU-GPU chemistry workflow (QSCI) splitting work between IQM's 20-qubit Garnet processor and AMD Instinct GPUs on ROCm, validated on H2 across 17 bond lengths. It is explicitly an interoperability validation, not a quantum-advantage claim, but it gives HPC centers a non-NVIDIA multi-vendor option.

insights.claim: IQM Quantum Computers and AMD demonstrated an end-to-end hybrid quantum-classical chemistry workflow running on IQM's 20-qubit superconducting Garnet processor and AMD Instinct GPUs using the open-source ROCm stack.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: AMD is positioning ROCm as a quantum-HPC integration layer, challenging NVIDIA's CUDA-Q default in supercomputing centers.
insights.locator: IQM Quantum Computers (Nasdaq: IQMX) and AMD

insights.claim: The IQM-AMD collaboration establishes a multi-vendor alternative for supercomputing centers that want to integrate quantum processors with classical GPU accelerators.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Procurement optionality beyond a single GPU vendor could matter for HPC centers buying QPUs; watch whether other QPU vendors add ROCm support.
insights.quote: the collaboration establishes a multi-vendor alternative for supercomputing centers
insights.locator: IQM Quantum Computers (Nasdaq: IQMX) and AMD

insights.claim: The IQM-AMD hybrid chemistry work is the first installment of a planned technical series, with the partners working toward tighter physical interconnects and larger molecular active spaces above eight qubits.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Follow-on installments are the signal for whether the partnership deepens into physical QPU-GPU coupling.
insights.locator: The teams validated the full pipeline

insights.claim: The workflow uses Quantum-Selected Configuration Interaction (QSCI): the QPU samples bitstrings to identify dominant electron configurations, while the GPU filters unphysical samples, builds the projected subspace Hamiltonian and diagonalizes it with cubic O(N3) scaling in JAX on ROCm, avoiding the exponential memory scaling of exact classical diagonalization.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: QSCI-style sample-then-diagonalize workflows push most compute onto GPUs, so near-term quantum chemistry drives classical accelerator demand too.
insights.locator: The workflow implements Quantum-Selected Configuration Interaction

insights.claim: The IQM Garnet processor was accessed via the IQM Resonance cloud platform to prepare a parameterized trial circuit for the chemistry workflow.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Cloud QPU access plus cloud GPU instances lowers the barrier to hybrid experimentation.
insights.locator: The workflow implements Quantum-Selected Configuration Interaction

insights.claim: The IQM-AMD pipeline was validated on molecular hydrogen (H2, minimal STO-3G basis), reproducing the dissociation curve across 17 bond lengths on physical hardware, and required resolving ROCm version-pinning dependencies for hybrid execution.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: H2 is a toy problem; software-stack friction (version pinning) is the real near-term hurdle for hybrid deployments.
insights.locator: The teams validated the full pipeline

insights.claim: The IQM-AMD hybrid chemistry demo is framed as an interoperability validation rather than a demonstration of quantum advantage.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Investors should not read this as a commercial chemistry breakthrough; it is plumbing.
insights.quote: Candidly framed as an interoperability validation rather than a demonstration of quantum advantage
insights.locator: The teams validated the full pipeline

insights.claim: The IQM-AMD workflow is released as an open-source Jupyter notebook on IQM Academy, runnable on AMD Developer Cloud GPU instances.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Developer-adoption funnel play by both vendors; track notebook usage and ROCm mentions in quantum developer surveys.
insights.locator: The teams validated the full pipeline
